instruction: Candid studio medium photograph of two women posing in front of a plain white wall. On the left, the woman with voluminous afro hair (R1) in a mauve shirt makes a 'T' hand gesture while smiling. On the right, the woman with short brown hair (R2) in a striped shirt smiles warmly with closed eyes. They stand side-by-side under soft, even lighting.
elements: R1 is the woman making a 'T' hand gesture while smiling
R2 is the woman smiling warmly with closed eyes
R1 and R2 pose side-by-side with distinct gestures/expressions
plain white wall studio setting under soft, even lighting
